description: This file declares the JsonParsable interface, which provides methods for parsing objects of type T from JSON representations and headers within the Eclipse Ditto project. It defines default and abstract methods for JSON parsing, including exception handling.

classes.name: JsonParsable
classes.description: A functional interface for parsing objects of type T from JSON strings or objects along with headers, supporting JSON parsing within the Ditto framework.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Default method that parses an instance of T from a JSON string and headers by converting the string to a JsonObject.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Abstract method that parses an instance of T from a JsonObject and headers, to be implemented by classes.
